text:
Save this before you land at Narita
with an Asakusa hotel booked 📌

1️⃣ Read the line name in the hotel's directions.
"Asakusa Station" can mean four stations.

2️⃣ Ride the Access Express from Narita.
70 minutes, ¥1,380, no change.

3️⃣ Need step-free? Use exit A2b.

4️⃣ Plan the way back from the same station.

🏮 Get it right and your first evening
starts with a short walk to the lanterns.

👉 The guide:
https://japanbystation.com/asakusa-which-station-from-narita
